description: Everything SuliHuli holds on one electric vehicle: range per test cycle (WLTP, EPA, CLTC, NEDC), charging, efficiency, battery and the other specs, prices per market and version with their dates, and every figure's source link, date and status (verified or unverified; where sources disagree, each figure is shown with its source, never averaged). The headline figures describe one named version; the answer names every version we know. For another version pass `version` (name words such as 'long range awd', or a key from the list) and get that version's own figures. Short by default: the headline figures, the named version's price per market and the version names; `sections` gives any part whole (every figure, every price row, each version's summary, the full Markdown page with photo credits). Use it to answer any question about a specific model, quoting the figure with its cycle, source and status.

locale.description: Language of the answer's text and page links (default en): en.

prices_page.description: Page of the full price list with sections ['prices'] (default 1); see prices_pages.

sections.description: Optional parts to give whole: figures (every figure with its source), prices (every price row of every market and version, in pages of 40), versions (each version's sourced figures), page (the full Markdown page as text). Without it the answer is short. Parts that would pass 40 000 characters together are named in sections_left for another call.

slug.description: Model slug as search_models returns it (also the last part of the page URL https://sulihuli.com/m/<slug>), e.g. 'hyundai-ioniq-6'. A version slug such as 'tesla-model-y-long-range-awd' also works.

version.description: Optional: a version key or name words, e.g. 'long range awd'. Without it the answer describes the named version and lists the others.
